tool_input.command: python3 -m pytest -q -n 0 -o addopts="" tests/scenarios/test_work_queue.py 2>&1 | tail -3; env | grep -i work_item

result:
The five scenarios for requests r8–r12 now pass. I could not run `tests/scenarios/test_work_queue.py` on its own, though, so one of my test changes is unchecked.

- **What can now be done:** `work` has three new commands, `outcome`, `turn` and `resolve`, in a new module `scripts/workqueue_request.py`. Each commits only the request file it changed, on the current branch.
- **Red run:** before the code, the five scenarios failed with `invalid choice: 'outcome'` (and likewise for `turn` and `resolve`), because the commands did not exist.
- **Green run:** `python3 -m pytest -q --work-item w128` gave 147 passed, 1 skipped, and `tests/scripts` gave 141 passed. The size check printed nothing.
- **Unchecked change:** in this session a `--work-item w128` filter is applied to every pytest run, so `test_work_queue.py` is filtered out. I changed `new_commit_holds` in `tests/scenarios/work_queue_git_steps.py` to accept a request id as well as a path. A plain path should resolve as before, but `work run`'s whole-suite run is the real check.
- **Choices I made:**
  - **`resolve` input:** it takes `work resolve <request> --line N REQ VERSION`, once per accepted line.
  - **`resolve` refusal:** it is refused on a request that is not `accepted`.
  - **Unknown request id:** a request id that doesn't exist is refused rather than crashing.
  - **Request file form:** it follows the plan.
- **Cases the scenarios don't cover:** these are listed under `## Open questions` in the report and left unchosen. They include a duplicate line number, an unknown outcome word, and `turn` when every line is withdrawn (it comes out refused).
- **Merge risk:** `scripts/workqueue_request.py` and the request step definitions are shared with w126 and w127, so the second of them to merge may clash.
- **Not fixed, as the plan said:**
  - `work withdraw` accepting a request.
  - `model check` reporting the requests directory as an initiative with no `initiative.md`.

I changed six files and made one commit, `15b3801`.

The report and result file are in `.shop/scratch/3-implement/`; the result status is `DONE`.
